values.meaning: shield strength when Flow is consumed
values.binNote: Wiki computes the shield with a nonlinear per-level formula (quadratic acceleration term 0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) that back-calculates to the values listed here; the bin's YasuoPassive#ShieldValue instead appears to be a plain linear interpolation from 125 at level 1 to 600 at level 18 (step ~27.94/level, e.g. 152.9 at level 2 vs the wiki's 145.1). The endpoints (125, 600) agree but the intermediate levels do not; using the wiki's stated formula here.

values.quote: grant himself a {{tip|shield}} for ... that lasts for 1 second
values.binNote: No bin row for the 1 second shield lifetime; it is only stated in the description text.

values.meaning: Yasuo's critical strikes deal only a reduced percentage of normal crit damage
values.quote: {{fd|{{#expr:{{ccd|Yasuo|crit_mod}}*100}}}}% of the {{sti|{{as|critical damage}}}} champions usually have

values.meaning: bonus AD gained per 1% critical strike chance in excess of 100%
values.quote: every {{as|1% critical strike chance}} in excess of {{as|100%|critical strike chance}} is converted into {{sti|{{as|{{fd|0.5}} '''bonus''' attack damage}}}}
